units.source_text: “浅草的观音堂里，立着一尊团十郎的铜像。

en.t: Inside the Kannon Hall at Asakusa stands a bronze statue of Danjuro.

units.source_text: 它使出浑身解数叉开双腿，是一种叫‘暂’的什么舞台姿势。

en.t: It stands with its legs spread wide, as if putting all its strength into it, in some stage pose called Shibaraku.

units.source_text: 我每次看到这副模样，觉得它实在太辛苦了。

en.t: Every time I see it like that, I feel it must be terribly hard on him.

units.source_text: 一年到头那样使劲扭着脑袋，实际上也受不了吧。

en.t: Twisting his head with such effort all year round would surely be unbearable in reality.
I really feel sorry for Danjuro.
